title: Long-lived computer Phase 1: snapshot v2 index, streaming pack and a read-only Files view
description: Done 2026-10-12 (PRs 513 design, 515 server, 514 web). Snapshot v2: per-file gzip members, index/<checksum>.json, manifest names the index checksum, exclusions (node_modules etc, files over 50 MiB), streaming multipart pack (RSS growth +45 MB for 50 MB, +32 MB for 200 MB), change detection by size and mtime. Routes GET /orgs/:t/computer/files, /stat, /content (read-only, membership checked, masked secrets, hash verified). Web: inspector Files tab, viewer, Files Pi touched. Development snapshots re-indexed with conversation/bin/reindex-snapshots.ts (idempotent). Verified live: the Files tab lists /workspace (fib, fib.c, squares, squares.c), opens squares.c (cubes version, sha256 e522e977c357), and shows Binary file for the compiled program. Not verified live: masked file, images, a 400 MB workspace publish, a bot creating a new folder.
right_now_summary: Snapshot v2 and the read-only Files view work live, but several edge cases remain untested.
